svg.title: Two normalized Maxwell-Boltzmann speed distributions
svg.desc: The left curve is narrower with a higher peak. The right curve is broader with a lower peak and greater average speed. Both have equal area. Higher temperature at fixed gas mass, or smaller molar mass at fixed temperature, produces the broader distribution.
